verdict.rationale: RingCentral's developer portal references first-party MCP servers ('Try our MCP servers', 'See MCP servers') and its marketing says it can connect to LLMs like ChatGPT and Claude, so an official MCP server appears to exist. The evidence is only link-text-level mentions, with no setup, tooling or auth details, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's tools and capabilities, connection/setup instructions for agent clients, an auth model for MCP access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect RingCentral to your favorite LLMs like ChatGPT & Claude
